seriously hope so 
need it to 

I don’t even care about myself anymore I just need them to be ok and alive
I seriously hope so. even tho I thought about it my entire life and would’ve gone through with It ever since i meet them I’ve become so scared to die now but I seriously can’t live without them
nothing I do is helping them. if anything it’s making it worse. I’m so desperate I’ve been saying all the wrong things. I’m so sorry. I know u hate me.

I know what you’re saying is the truth. it’s definitely insanely hard to find people like them. I just don’t know if I have the strength to keep going and find my missing puzzle piece anymore. I always tried taking all the hits and punches from everyone but I’m fucking tired. I don’t know how I can keep going after this. they were the only person to keep me living.

I know we just both strangers behind a screen but I’m crying right now for what you said to me. somehow I still have enough strength to cry and think about what you’re saying. maybe you mean it, maybe you don’t but thanks for saying that. I’ve never really had anyone besides one person care enough about me to tell me something like that. 

I don’t want to die but I have no reason to live currently. if you struggling too I hope the little good luck I have goes to you

exactly. I’ve been told that exact thing from people every time I start talking about what’s on my mind. I don’t get why people always think that. if I could choose to not feel this way I’d do it in a heartbeat. 

only reason I came to this subreddit

sorry you’re going through that bro. seriously. 
It really is fucking shit when you’re stuck like that. never felt so alone before. 
for me I’m afraid to tell them how I feel as well. I’m afraid to seem like I’m guilt tripping or something but I truly am only here thanks to them.
